audit.scope: Round 2 (final) of the uncommitted change in worktree C:/Users/jdk/dispatch-board-worktrees/PBI-004 (branch pbi/PBI-004-shared-derivation, base 049f27e): git diff of exporters/export_board.py, export_catalogue.py and export_sessions.py, plus the untracked exporters/derive.py and tests/test_derive.py, re-read in full. Intent rung 2 (work-item AC): docs/backlog/pbi/PBI-004.md D-1 to D-5 and the close-out line, together with the round-1 findings (findings-r1.json) and the builder's round-2 claims (change-report-r2.json). Grounding: ran all three repo suites read-only; ran an in-process before/after probe (parse_session from the base 049f27e exporters, extracted to scratch, against the worktree's exporters) on every real main transcript under ~/.claude/projects with the same now; did an AST comparison of top-level names, base against new, for the three exporter modules; checked every object that agent_summary and session_result return for aliasing of the running state by reading the code. Security is reasoning-only (no Touchstone SARIF).
audit.summary: Change class: large (a ~800-line move of executable exporter code into a shared module; no behaviour change intended). 0 CRITICAL / 0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM / 1 LOW (maintainability). Dimensions covered: correctness, security, maintainability, test-adequacy. Round-1 status: CR-PBI004-01 (MEDIUM) is resolved. agent_summary now returns a fresh resps list, and each entry is a copy with its own tools list. It also returns a copied rejects list. Its usage dict is replaced, never mutated, when a streamed response continues. session_result returns skillUses as per-skill dict copies. The rest of doc (usage_doc output, strings) is newly built, and rows/skipped are caller-owned, so nothing returned still aliases new_session/new_agent state. CR-PBI004-02 (LOW) is resolved: export_sessions.use_skill has been removed; a grep of exporters/, tests/ and local/ finds no reference, and D-3 does not name it. CR-PBI004-03 (LOW) is resolved for the items it headlined: carried, excluded, project_doc and a feed-derive-feed case, for both session_result and agent_summary. Each new test asserts behaviour: a deepcopy snapshot equals the first result, and the second result equals a one-shot parse. verdict_of on the ver lane and usage_doc limit grouping are still tested only through the exporter suites. That deferral is acceptable: those paths are covered and did not change. Output is unchanged: the before/after probe found 25 of 25 real sessions with identical parse_session results. That is consistent with the builder's claim of 157 of 157 files identical. Suites, run here: 300 OK, 89 passed, 90 OK. No pre-existing test was edited (only tests/test_derive.py is new). AC-alignment: D-1 to D-5 met; the close-out on the head commit cannot be verified until the change is committed. Security: no new input boundary and no I/O in derive. Flag-only: nothing was changed, staged, committed, pushed or deployed in the worktree.
